source_evidence: D327~15:35 exact player 'Lets pay him a vist' authorizes leaving completed Sallow audience and visiting Noldren Tavosk's known public petition office in Orsaven Exchange district. Ordinary walk together V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar, no new fee, check or rest. Actual first-play office availability: Tavosk is receiving ordinary commercial callers this afternoon; party gives routine introduction and presents Sallow's signed letter for inspection without surrendering custody. Tavosk reads it and returns it to V, admits group for ordinary commercial discussion. Newly adjudicated scene: Exchange corridor busy with petitioners, office tall windows, dark wood desk, orderly folded petitions; Tavosk a well-dressed middle-aged man with swept brown hair, blue coat with copper-toned embroidery, composed practiced courtesy (visual references https://i.pinimg.com/originals/4d/09/5f/4d095f3872e08db2dae9715966501950.jpg and https://forumcontent.paradoxplaza.com/public/1189477/_d5a701e7-2ee5-4d62-9779-2fc7c23ea8c6.jpeg as inspiration only). He knows his own petition work, paid inspection-warning arrangements and relevant contacts as fixed in prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516; he sees a credible referral and knows V's stated commercial interests, not automatically the covert investigation, Watch exhibits, Halvessa/Sallow exact admissions or the earlier missing acknowledgement. Tavosk opens: 'Sallow does not often send me new clients himself. I understand you have freight interests upriver. Tell me, my lord: are you looking for a change to the rules, or something that would help your carriers in the meantime?' No actual disclosure of illicit fee, concrete advance warning arrangement, confession, agreement, payment, or new V speech beyond ordinary presentation; no disputed concession attempted yet. Mara is available to reinforce genuine commercial pretext, Cirren listening, Fenar attentive. Harthvale introduction request still pending; no actual dispatch/receipt established. Desen not yet informed of afternoon findings. V controls next reply.
